channel.title: RAN Air Wing dev blog
channel.description: HMAS Melbourne (R21) flight sim: history, carrier operations and dev diary.

item.title: Welcome to RAN Air Wing
item.description: A browser flight sim of HMAS Melbourne and her air wing, set in 1977-1982, and a blog that tells the history behind it.

item.title: A jointed pilot and a longer ejection
item.description: The pilot now has a head, torso, arms and legs, and an ejection runs as a sequence from seat rocket to parachute to landing.

item.title: Fly the S-2 Tracker
item.description: The S-2 Tracker is now flyable from the catapult and onto the angled deck, with a slower, heavier propeller feel than the Skyhawk.

item.title: The task group: Perth, Derwent and Supply join Melbourne
item.description: Three escorts now keep station around the carrier, based on the task group that sailed with Melbourne in 1980.
